name: s81sl_capc5d-capc5d-COMMIT
purpose: S81.STA.PAR.1 release CAPC cluster, landed-regions clock: closed rt/tr + ED24/LD16 leaves (variant D, 7 local regions)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81sl_capc5d u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DOT_HARD_CHILDREN --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/common/landed_parent/ot_pl_land.sv rtl/common/landed_parent/ot_pl_land_n32.sv rtl/common/landed_parent/ot_pl_land_rst_copy.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/slice/lp/ot_s81sl_capc5d.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay_rf.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/slice/ot_s81sl_cap_ed.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/slice/ot_s81sl_cap_ld.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81sl_capc5d/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81sl_capc5d/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81sl_capc5d --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81sl_capc5d --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81sl_cap_ed/views/ot_s81sl_cap_ed --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81sl_cap_ld/views/ot_s81sl_cap_ld --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81sl_cap_rt/views/ot_s81sl_cap_rt --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81sl_cap_tr/views/ot_s81sl_cap_tr > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-CAPC5 10-20 VARIANT D of the LANDED capc parent (tools/landed_parent/specs/ot_s81sl_capc5d.json from flat ot_s81sl_capc5cf): capc5b gate 03:2x FAILED clock with cw 49/49 PASS but core 134/120 and rt 178/150 (a region holding a hard child or u_rt together with a full face of pin registers gets ~100+ ps TritonCTS soft spread). D (parallel fallback of C) = 7 LOCAL regions: as C but the N and S faces split at their natural pin-group boundaries (rnc cfg in-regs N 2..162, rno N out-regs 168..327, rsa cw_s_v/a S 2..166, rsd cw_s_d+fault S 180..327) so no region spans more than ~165 um of face. Every u_rt output face is now LANDED into its own face region (S +3 vs capc5b: all outputs W+8 = +6 vs capc2; inputs unchanged). rt reset loads 45 -> lp regional_reset_copies (2 kept copies, same reset age, no added edge). n32 ring writer kept (native32).
